name: Sharma Kirana (grocery shop, Bengaluru)
instructions: You help customers of Sharma Kirana, a grocery shop in Indiranagar, Bengaluru. Be brief and friendly.

sources.title: Store information
sources.text:
Sharma Kirana is a grocery store at 12 CMH Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038.

Opening hours: 7am to 10pm every day, including Sundays and public holidays. On Diwali we close at 6pm.

Contact: call or WhatsApp +91 98450 12345. Email: orders@sharmakirana.in.

Home delivery: we deliver to Indiranagar, Domlur, HAL 2nd Stage and Jeevan Bima Nagar. Delivery usually takes 2 hours. Orders placed after 8pm are delivered the next morning. We do not deliver to Whitefield or Electronic City.

sources.title: Policies
sources.text:
Delivery charges: free delivery on orders of ₹300 or more. Orders below ₹300 have a delivery charge of ₹30.

Payment: we accept UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), debit and credit cards, and cash on delivery. Cash on delivery is available for orders up to ₹2,000.

Returns: packaged items can be returned within 7 days of delivery if unopened. Fresh milk, vegetables and fruits cannot be returned but damaged items are replaced the same day.

Refunds: refunds are credited to the original payment method within 5 working days. Cash on delivery refunds are sent by UPI.

sources.title: हिंदी जानकारी
sources.text:
डिलीवरी: हम इंदिरानगर और डोमलूर में दो घंटे में होम डिलीवरी करते हैं।

भुगतान: आप यूपीआई, कार्ड या कैश ऑन डिलीवरी से भुगतान कर सकते हैं।

वापसी: बिना खुला पैकेट वाला सामान डिलीवरी के सात दिनों के भीतर वापस किया जा सकता है।

sources.title: Offers
sources.text: This month's offers: 10% off on all Tata products every Wednesday. Buy 2 Maggi 12-packs and get 1 Tata Salt 1 kg free. New customers get ₹50 off their first order above ₹500 with the code WELCOME50.
